description: This file implements helper functions for remote action mapping including RF key handling, IR code management, and interaction with RIB entries and IARM bus calls. It manages RF network IDs, remote controller bindings, setting and retrieving IR & RF database mappings, and device power control logic for a C++ based embedded or set-top box system.

classes.name: RemoteActionMappingHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for managing remote action mappings, RF remote bindings, IR code database interactions, device power state management, and IR-RF database entries via IARM bus calls in a set-top box or embedded device context.

methods.name: getRf4ceNetworkID
methods.description: Retrieves the RF4CE network ID by calling IARM bus status and parsing the response.

methods.name: getRf4ceBindRemotes
methods.description: Queries IARM network status to retrieve the list of bound RF4CE remotes/controllers, ordered by most recent activity.

methods.name: getLastUsedDeviceID
methods.description: Returns the device ID of the most recently used RF4CE remote, along with its type and IR database status.

methods.name: getControllerByID
methods.description: Gets detailed controller info by device ID from the RF4CE network.

methods.name: setKeyActionMap
methods.description: Sets a key action mapping in the IR-RF database for a specific device and key, including constructing RIB requests and RF descriptors.

methods.name: getKeyActionMap
methods.description: Retrieves the key action mapping from the IR-RF database for a specific device and key.

methods.name: clearKeyActionMap
methods.description: Clears the RF database entry for a specific device and key, optionally clearing associated device power entries.

methods.name: setDevicePower
methods.description: Sets the power IR code for a device, managing separate RF key slots for TV and AVR if IR codes are present.

methods.name: clearDevicePower
methods.description: Clears the power IR code entries for RF keys related to power toggle, on, and off.

methods.name: setRIBDevicePower
methods.description: Sets a specific RF key in the IR-RF database with the provided IR data.

methods.name: clearRIBDevicePower
methods.description: Clears a specific RF key in the IR-RF database, setting it back to default/disabled.

methods.name: setIRDBDownloadFlag
methods.description: Sets or clears the flag for IR database download on a device via RIB entries.

methods.name: setFiveDigitCode
methods.description: Stores 5-digit TV and AVR codes into the RIB database, setting associated flags and clearing unrelated bits.

methods.name: setFiveDigitCodeFlags
methods.description: Sets or clears IRRF status flags related to 5-digit code download modes, in the RIB database.

methods.name: getControllerLoadStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the load/status bytes for TV and AVR from the controller's IRDB status in the RIB, indicating their current IR code presence and download status.

methods.name: cancelCodeDownload
methods.description: Cancels pending IR-RF code downloads by checking the IRRF download flag in RIB, clearing database entries if needed, and resetting related flags.

methods.name: lookupRFKey
methods.description: Maps internal key identifiers to RF key constants.

methods.name: lookupKeyname
methods.description: Maps RF key constants back to internal key identifiers.
